messages:
mia.h: Heads-up — noticed a spike of Vault decryption failures in staging around 09:12 UTC. Apps reading KMS-wrapped Vault secrets get 403/unable to unwrap. Creating channel for containment and rotation coordination.
sec-oncall: Thanks, can you paste the exact error from the app logs? Any evidence of creds exfil?
mia.h: Log snippet below (sanitized). Seems like wrap key decryption fails: 
```
2026-03-23T09:12:03Z auth: vault unwrap failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = failed to decrypt: KMS: 'projects/x/locations/global/keyRings/ring1/cryptoKeys/ck-2024' not available for decryption
2026-03-23T09:12:04Z secret: read failed: 403
```
sec-oncall: Ok — treat as inability to access KMS key, not clear leak. Check audit logs and KMS IAM.
devops-jen: ops-bot created incident INC-2026-734 for tracking :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-734 created by devops-jen - Severity: P2 - Channel: #eng-security - Responders: sec-oncall, devops-jen
samir.k: I'm running a quick IAM diff on the KMS key. Taking a look at vault-transit IAM and GCP logs. ETA 8m.
ella_s: If KMS key policy was accidentally disabled or removed from the service account, Vault will fail unwrap. Also check if rotated key version is disabled.
samir.k: Found it — key version 3 was set to DISABLED by a manual ops job that had an old script. That explains the error. No external principal used. No evidence of exfil in the last 30m.
sec-oncall: Good find. Next steps: 1) re-enable key version to restore reads (hotfix), 2) freeze Vault writes that create new wrapped ciphertext until we finish a safe rotation, 3) run audit log review for last 24h, 4) plan rewrap to a new key version with a rotation window. Who takes 1 & 2?
devops-jen: I can re-enable key v3 now. Command I'm going to run: `gcloud kms keys versions enable 3 --key ring ring1 --location global --key ck-2024 --project redwood-inference`
mia.h: After re-enable, we should route reads to fallback key version if available. Also patch a temporary RBAC policy to prevent any non-oncall users from creating new key versions in that key ring.
samir.k: Re-enable done. Staging reads recovered ~09:22. Monitoring shows error count dropping to zero.
ella_s: I'll patch RBAC: apply a temporary deny binding for `roles/cloudkms.admin` to a small list. Command: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding --member user:persona@redwood.com --role roles/cloudkms.admin` (we'll do scoped group change, not user-by-user). ETA 5m.
sec-oncall: Hold on RBAC full removal until we confirm we won't block the rotation. Instead add a conditional approval workflow: create a temporary IAM condition that only allows key version creation from CI service account with tag `kms-rotation=true`.
samir.k: Agreed. I'll open a short-lived IAM condition and notify SRE.
devops-jen: Also we need to rotate any ciphertext that might have been created with disabled version — rewrap plan: 1) create new key version v4, 2) perform Vault rewrap (vault operator rewrap) in controlled batches, 3) verify consumer apps against canary secrets, 4) mark v3 disabled after verification. Proposed window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC to minimize impact.
mia.h: Add partner notification: there was a partner ingest webhook that read a subset of staging logs — we found log fragments referencing KMS key id but no ciphertext. Notify partner infra point-of-contact to confirm they didn't capture any secret payloads. We should treat as low-risk but inform.
sec-oncall: I'll draft the external note. Keep it minimal: no plaintext leaked, key id referenced only.
ops-bot: Action created: INC-2026-734-A1 — Rewrap staging secrets to new key version (owner: samir.k)
ops-bot: Action created: INC-2026-734-A2 — RBAC conditional policy for key creation (owner: ella_s)
samir.k: Starting rewrap dry-run against 5 non-critical secrets now: `vault write -f sys/rewrap -mount=transit key=ck-2024` (dry-run flag)
devops-jen: Remember to snapshot Vault encrypted blobs and GCS backups before rewrap. I'll take a backup at 01:45 UTC.
mia.h: Post-rotation verification checklist: 1) app reads OK for canary secrets, 2) auditlog shows rewrap actor is vault-service-account, 3) no unauthorized principals created key versions.
sec-oncall: After rotation we'll run 24h heightened audit retention and a swift RBAC sweep to prune any transient grants. Postmortem to be scheduled for tomorrow EOD.
ella_s: RBAC condition applied and unit-tested against a staging CI job — only service account with label `kms-rotation=true` can create key versions.
samir.k: Rewrap completed for 95% secrets at 02:12 UTC, canary reads OK. Leaving v3 disabled.
devops-jen: Backups taken, no errors. Rolling window closed.
sec-oncall: Great containment and coordination — no evidence of data exfil, root cause was an old scripted job disabling key versions. Owners: samir.k will lead rewrap cleanup, ella_s will harden IAM conditions, devops-jen will update backup playbooks, mia.h will notify partner and draft postmortem.
mia.h: Filing follow-up tasks in the incident board and scheduling postmortem doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: secrets management incident thread — containment + rotation coordination
